title: She Fell 3 km From a Plane… and Lived ✈️ #shorts
cast: a brave 17-year-old girl with short dark hair in a sleeveless dress and one sandal, cartoon style

lines.say: A teenage girl fell out of a plane, three kilometres above the rainforest. And she survived.
shots: {hero} falling through clouds still strapped in a plane seat, rainforest far below
close-up of {hero} with wide eyes, wind in her hair

lines.say: It was Christmas Eve, 1971. Juliane Koepcke and her mother were flying over the Peruvian Amazon.
shots: a small 1970s propeller airliner flying over endless green rainforest
{hero} and her mother sitting by an airplane window, smiling

lines.say: A lightning storm hit the plane, and it broke apart in the sky.
shots: a plane in a dark thunderstorm, lightning bolts all around
dark storm clouds with flashes of lightning

lines.say: Juliane fell, still strapped to her seat. The thick trees broke her fall.
shots: {hero} in her seat crashing through giant rainforest trees and vines
{hero} waking up on the forest floor under huge leaves

lines.say: She had a broken collarbone, one sandal, and no map. But her father, a biologist, had taught her something.
shots: {hero} standing up holding her shoulder in a dark jungle
a memory scene of a father showing a map of rivers to his daughter

lines.say: Follow the water. Streams lead to rivers, and rivers lead to people.
shots: {hero} walking in a shallow jungle stream
a river winding through the rainforest seen from above

lines.say: For eleven days she waded downstream, until she found a hut, and loggers who brought her to safety.
shots: {hero} finding a small wooden hut by a riverbank
friendly loggers in a canoe helping {hero}, sunlight through trees

lines.say: She was the only survivor. Would you have known to follow the water?
shots: {hero} in a canoe gliding down a golden river at sunset
a single sandal resting on a rock by a stream

description:
On 24 December 1971, LANSA Flight 508 broke apart over the Peruvian rainforest. Juliane Koepcke, 17, fell still strapped to her seat, survived, and walked out of the jungle after 11 days. A true story.

Sources: Juliane Koepcke, 'When I Fell From the Sky'; Wikipedia: LANSA Flight 508.

Made with AI-assisted pictures and voice.
